purpose: build the API as specified so that clients get consistent, secure and well-behaved interfaces
entry_criteria: Data and business logic services are available
procedure: Generate or write the route and schema skeleton from the specification.
Implement handlers that validate every input against the schema and return the specified errors.
Enforce authentication and per-object authorization in one place and keep it out of handlers.
Add pagination, idempotency keys, rate limiting and request logging with correlation ids; never log secrets.
Write contract tests that run against the implementation and keep the specification and code in sync.
Document known differences from the specification and raise them for decision.
acceptance_criteria: Authorization is enforced centrally and tested
Logs have correlation ids and no secrets
validation_method: Code review (stage 69) and API test results (stage 81).

failure_modes.response: Fix code or update the contract by decision

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The orders API handlers reject bodies that fail schema validation with the specified 422 format, check object ownership through a shared dependency, and log a correlation id on each request.
